comment: Having tested the Audi, BMW, Mercedes and Porsche - this is lazy journalism.  The Porsche is the best for build quality and handling (be it hybrid or sport / sport plus mode).  All three and the Mercedes are over priced regardless and therefore 'quality for money' is thrown out of the window as buyers would look elsewhere if that was the priority.  As for the weight and brakes - none of these cars as exactly sports cars.  All are SUVs and weigh accordingly.  The Mercedes is great if you are looking for a boat feel.  The BMW is probably the car closest to the Porsche.  Having owned both a BMW X5 and a Porsche Cayenne, I would say that the Porsche is simply in a class above the BMW and the others in this comparison - be it the hybrid model or any of the pure petrol engines.  In truth though, all these cars really make no sense so whichever someone chooses to buy is likely down to subjective rationale rather than common sense.
